caption:
"Achhe doctor ko marketing ki zarurat nahi." Myth ya fact? 🤔

❌ Myth: patients word-of-mouth se aa hi jaate hain
✅ Fact: aaj patient pehle Google, Maps aur ChatGPT pe check karta hai, phir dost se poochta hai

Sabse sasta fix: Google Business Profile complete karo. 10+ photos, sahi timing, services list, aur har patient se review request. Kharcha ₹0, time 1 ghanta.

Ye "marketing" nahi, patient ki suvidha hai.

Save karo 🔖
Comment "AUDIT" 👇 hum aapka profile check karke 3-min video bhejenge. Free.

#clinicmarketing #googlebusinessprofile #doctorsofindia #digitalmarketingindia #parachar
